steps: administrator explicitly enables actions, configures owner application, and edits without reading or replacing its secret
real redirect callback binds current Identity, strips URL secrets, persists one personal account, survives reload and tests connection
second real Identity user cannot see first personal account or administrator application config
provider denial is a durable rejected receipt and creates no account or token exchange
changing Identity during vendor navigation prevents callback submission and token exchange; original owner can inspect the pending session
lost callback response recovers original receipt; reopening both persistent modules does not exchange code again
live Identity revocation applies immediately and remains revoked across restart; explicit restoration restores list

calendar-only consent stays available, probe scope explanation persists across restart, direct test is denied without provider I/O, no scopes are added
